title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a POS…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a POS endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access POS Opening Entries of other users without proper record-level permission checks. The vulnerability enables unauthorized reading of open POS sessions by sending crafted requests referencing other records.
